title: feat(spec): a generic record:json record block — one record key as indented JSON behind a required, fail-closed requiredPermissions gate
body:
Fixes #23745

Clause-②: yes

## What

The spec half of face 4 of objectstack-ai/objectui#12438's ruling (letter C, ruling `6190549995`): a generic `record:json` record block. It draws one key of the bound record as indented JSON, in a panel that starts collapsed, with a copy control. A REQUIRED, fail-closed `requiredPermissions` gate sits in front of it.

- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`: `'record:json'` is a `PageComponentType` member. It is also classified in `PRINT_REFUSED_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` (a panel that starts collapsed, behind a per-viewer gate). `page-print.test.ts` requires every vocabulary member to be classified the day it lands.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`: `RecordJsonProps` is strict, uses `PROPS_HISTORY` and `COMPONENT_LEVEL_GUIDANCE`, and is registered in `ComponentPropsMap` as `'record:json'`. It has three keys:
  - `field`: required. A string in the snake_case machine-name grammar.
  - `label`: optional. `I18nLabelSchema`, the summary line.
  - `requiredPermissions`: **required**. `z.array(z.string().min(1)).min(1)`. Its describe says the gate fails CLOSED, that it is presentation only and authorises nothing, and that the read route still serves the value.
  - Aliases name the declared key for near spellings (`key`/`path` → `field`, `title` → `label`, `permissions` → `requiredPermissions`).
- The record blocks' shared fail-OPEN `requiredPermissions` (`RECORD_BLOCK_REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS_DESCRIPTION`) is **untouched**, as the ruling requires. `record:json` declares the same key name as a separate declaration with its own text.
- Regenerated artifacts (`check:generated --fix`, five proved stale): `api-surface/`, `authorable-surface/`, `declaration-map/`, `export-origins/`, `json-schema.manifest/`, `content/docs/references/**`, and the strictness-ledger counts.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` `minor`.

## Tables that enumerate record component types (each hit judged)

Hits of `git grep -n "'record:details'" -- packages/spec/src packages/lint/src` in source files:

| Hit | Verdict |
|---|---|
| `page.zod.ts` `PageComponentType` | **added** |
| `page.zod.ts` `PRINTABLE_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` / `PRINT_REFUSED_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` | **added to REFUSED** (pinned exhaustive by `page-print.test.ts`) |
| `component.zod.ts` `ComponentPropsMap` | **added** |
| `react-blocks.ts` `RECORD_CONTEXT_BLOCK_TAGS` | no edit: derived from `ComponentPropsMap` by the `record:` prefix, so `<RecordJson>` on a react page is covered automatically (`check:react-blocks` green) |
| `react-blocks.ts` `REACT_RECORD_BLOCK_ALTERNATIVES` | no edit: optional per-block advice; types without an entry get the generic advice |
| `lint` `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` `COMPONENT_FIELD_SPECS` | **deliberately not added**: `field`'s first value (`payload` on `sys_approval_request`) is a route-served key, not a declared field, so an entry would refuse the downstream page |
| `conversions/registry.ts` (6 hits) | no edit: the fixtures of one `record:details` conversion |
| `page.zod.ts:1097` | no edit: prose in a refusal message |

Test census edited: `component-record-block-field-security.test.ts` counts the rows that declare `requiredPermissions`. It now names `record:json`. The "one key, one text" pin over the four shared declarations is unchanged.

## Liveness

`packages/spec/liveness/page.json` classifies no component-level key. `regions` is an undrilled container (#4956). The `regions` row carries the component-member READ POINTS only as an evidence list with no verdict. `record:json` has no renderer (objectui#12490 step 4) and no producer (#23746) yet. So there is no read point to cite and no row to add. Inventing one would be fabricated evidence. No gate requires a per-row entry: I grepped `scripts/`, `packages/spec/scripts` and `packages/lint/src` for a reader of that list and found none. `check:liveness` is green.

## Boundary: `field` is not checked against declared fields

I looked for an existing declared spelling that could say "a served key". The closest is `ObjectSchema.attachedOnRead` (#22211, ruling A). It declares per-caller blocks with a FIXED set of scalar leaves (`number | text | boolean | date`). A request snapshot's leaves are the source record's fields, which vary per request. So it cannot describe `payload` without being widened, and this PR does not widen it. Result: a misspelled `field` draws nothing, and publish cannot catch it. This is stated in the describe, the schema header and the changeset. The trade-off is recorded in the report's `open_questions` for the contract review.

## Acceptance notes

- `requiredPermissions` elements are `z.string().min(1)`, one notch tighter than the fit check's `z.string()`: a gate naming `''` can never be passed and would draw nothing for everyone, silently.
- PR #23708 edits other regions of `page.zod.ts`. Whichever PR lands second merges `main`.
- #23746 (placing the block on `sys-approval-request.page.ts`) and objectui#12490 step 4 (the renderer) are not part of this PR.

## Tests

- New: `packages/spec/src/ui/component-record-json.test.ts` (enum member, row identity, accepted contract, unknown key refusal with a lit control, near-spelling guidance, `field` grammar, required and fail-closed gate, shared gate unchanged, print refusal).
- New: `packages/lint/src/validate-record-json-23745.test.ts` (`component-type-unknown` offers `record:json`; `component-props-unknown-key`; `component-props-invalid` for a missing or empty gate and a missing `field`; `page-field-unknown` stays silent on a route-served `field`, with a firing control on `record:highlights`).
- `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`: `RecordJsonProps` pinned isomorphic (ADR-0122; 787 → 788).
- Local runs: see the os-dev report comment on #23745 for commands, exit codes and the gate reconciliation.
